2026_04_JAX_CIN.headline: Jacksonville’s stingy start faces Joe Burrow and Cincinnati at Paycor Stadium
2026_04_JAX_CIN.paragraph1: Jacksonville travels to Cincinnati after allowing only three touchdowns through three games, setting up a direct test against Joe Burrow and a Bengals offense that wants to create favorable passing matchups. Cincinnati must protect well enough to let routes develop, particularly with rookie receiver Colbie Young expected to miss the game. The Jaguars can tilt the matchup by keeping Burrow under pressure and tackling cleanly underneath. Jacksonville’s offense, meanwhile, needs enough sustained drives to prevent Cincinnati from controlling possession and field position.
2026_04_JAX_CIN.model_rationale: Jacksonville’s defensive start gives it a credible way to disrupt Cincinnati, but protection, third-down execution and the Bengals’ ability to create explosive completions remain decisive.
